preferences: Preserve a coherent two-shot for physical comedy and simultaneous reactions when available; do not alternate merely to add cuts.
During a crescendo prefer tighter coverage; a release or meaningful group entrance can justify wider coverage if it exists.
Use a listener reaction on a meaningful revelation, challenge or emotional shift while preserving full speaker audio; prefer a readable return, with intentional endings as exceptions.
Preserve an existing natural silent response or visual punchline; never manufacture silence, freeze footage or add a fixed pause quota.
Do not truncate dialogue, cut words or apply subsecond reference pacing. Reaction inserts must last at least 1.5 seconds.
Reference timing estimates and cast identifiers are not rules or mappings for the current scene. Explicit author directions prevail.
